headline: Croajiro leap stance
title: Croajiro | Bounce High For An Attack Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Did you know a frog can launch you into the air? Croajiro is a Water and Dark Pal. Its partner skill, Leap Stance, makes it puff up so you can climb on top and be propelled high, and while you are airborne your Attack rises by fifty to eighty six percent. It also works Watering, Handiwork, Gathering and Transporting at level one. Will you try the Croajiro bounce? Comment below!
description: Croajiro in Palworld 1.0 is a Water and Dark Pal whose Leap Stance partner skill launches the player and raises Attack while airborne.
